title: Yellowish Malaysian Haddock Curry
description: A grassy and velvety Malaysian dish featuring haddock, this crowd-pleaser is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for all, with a unique flavor profile that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Rinse the haddock fillets under cold water, pat them dry with paper towels, and set aside.
Combine coconut milk, curry powder, turmeric, lemongrass, fish sauce, lime juice, salt, and black pepper in a large saucepan, whisking until smooth.
Bring the curry mixture to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and let cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the haddock fillets to the curry mixture, cover the saucepan with a lid, and steam for 8-10 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Remove the lemongrass stalks from the curry sauce and discard.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and let it heat through for 1 minute.
Serve the haddock curry hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
